decisions.finding: Initial Vav of ובְאָסְרָם consists of a bare vertical stem without internal Dagesh or Shuruq point, and white paper extends for 48 consecutive rows underneath. Confirmed unpointed consonant.
The internal cavity of Mem in הַמְקמִים contains zero ink (no Dagesh); beneath the base sits a two-dot Sheva. Confirmed unpointed consonant regarding Dagesh (bare Mem with Sheva: מְ).
Beneath the descending leg and base of Qof in הַמְקמִים, the paper is completely blank for 14 vertical rows; no Holam dot is present above. Confirmed unpointed consonant.

Beneath the initial Vav of וַיְבִיאוּם sits a distinct horizontal bar of ink (width 11 px, height 12 px, min=0) with clean surrounding margins. Matches control Patah bar. Certified printed Patah (U+05B7).

Under the initial Vav of ויַּשְׁלִיכוּם, 55 consecutive rows are pure white paper (values 255); the vowel mark and Dagesh are on the following Yod (יַּ). Confirmed unpointed consonant for initial Vav.
